dataset_identifiability.causal_limit: These defects permit shortcuts; CPU inspection alone does not prove which shortcut the model learned or that a particular shortcut caused the V2 failure.
confirmed_defects: Topology is a perfect query-count label: L->1, Z->3, T->2.
The first demonstration count equals the query count in all 48 tasks.
Every query uses foreground color 4 and rotation phase 3, so color/orientation are not independently crossed.

existing_prediction_evidence.available: aggregate frozen exact-grid and paired contrasts only
existing_prediction_evidence.unavailable: raw per-example V7/Control/Treatment predictions are not present in the committed evidence package, so error-transition attribution is NOT_RUN

highest_information_experiment.control: V7 initialization plus the original 48 confounded count tasks, the same 48 object-extraction tasks, and the same 288 replay slots.

failure_interpretation.good_train_fit_poor_ood: Prioritize object-centric representation/grounding rather than another similar SFT curriculum.
failure_interpretation.ood_gain_with_retention_loss: Test replay composition as a separate intervention.

highest_information_experiment.hypothesis: Breaking topology/count and demo-order shortcuts, while holding model, optimizer, updates, token mass, object-extraction slots, and replay fixed, improves free-running structural-OOD count accuracy.
highest_information_experiment.query_only_decision_rule: If Equal-Slot plus deconfounded data reaches <43/48 query train-fit while demonstration-output fit is >=90%, or if a separately authorized component-gradient measurement finds demo-versus-query cosine <=0, freeze a second two-arm comparison on identical deconfounded data: Equal-Slot CE versus Query-Only CE. Otherwise do not add the objective arm.
highest_information_experiment.query_only_followup: Run only as a separate matched experiment if the deconfounded arm has poor query train fit or a future component-gradient diagnostic shows demo-dominated or opposing query gradients.

success_gate.composition: No loss >1 correct versus Control; sentinel is a no-harm check, not evidence of compositional mastery.
success_gate.ood: Treatment-Control >=6/48 canonical units and canonical-unit paired bootstrap 95% lower bound >0.
success_gate.order_invariance: Treatment is correct under both demo orders on >=80% of its OOD-correct canonical units and is not worse than Control.
success_gate.promotion: No checkpoint promotion from this pilot alone; a newly frozen independent confirmation is required.
success_gate.retention: No protected family loses >1 correct versus Control and aggregate protected delta >=-2 correct.
success_gate.train_fit: Treatment reaches >=43/48 exact on its count-training queries; otherwise classify optimization/supervision failure.

highest_information_experiment.treatment: Same V7 initialization and identical non-count slots; replace only the 48 count tasks with the CPU-validated counterbalanced TRAIN-derived panel.

code_pair_reweighting.conclusion: The reweighting emphasizes the same two count-code cells in all four assistant outputs and leaves demo/query mass at 75/25; it is not query-only supervision.

effective_equal_slot_mass.definition: Each slot is independently mean-normalized, then contributes 1/4 of its optimizer-step objective. Fractions below are scalar objective coefficients before gradient norms/directions.

gradient_decomposition.required_future_measurement: At the common V7 start state, separately measure demo-output, query-output, query-decision, and formatting gradients on the frozen deconfounded panel; do not repeat the E04-D rotation-marker estimand.

causal_contract.alignment: PASS: weights are indexed in unshifted label coordinates and shifted beside the same labels; each selected label is predicted by logits at index-1.

code_pair_effect.conclusion: Code-Pair preserves total slot mass and the 75/25 demo/query split, but doubles the wrong cell pair: implemented columns 0/1 rather than documented columns 1/2.

confirmed_code_pair_defect.boundary: This confirms a supervision-locator defect; it does not by itself quantify how much of the V2 generalization failure it caused.
confirmed_code_pair_defect.impact: Implemented pair cannot distinguish Count 2 from Count 3 and overweights the always-foreground color/output-construction cell while omitting the third run cell.

objective_implementation.limits: Equal-Slot masking, causal shifting, and mass normalization pass. The Code-Pair semantic locator defect is confirmed, but its causal effect size is unknown without a controlled experiment.

mask_contract.assistant_turns: all assistant framing, grid digits/newlines, and end token supervised
mask_contract.interpretation: This is intentional all-assistant CE, not query-only CE.

nominal_equal_slot_objective_mass.definition: Each slot is independently mean-normalized, then contributes 1/4 of its optimizer-step objective. Fractions below are scalar objective coefficients before gradient norms/directions.

raw_supervised_token_exposure.warning: Raw token counts are exposure/accounting, not Equal-Slot objective weights.

objective_implementation.scope: Committed serializer, Equal-Slot loss, Code-Pair locator/weights, and connected-component worker call path; no model forward/backward.

ranked_bottlenecks.causal_status: Defect confirmed; causal contribution to model failure unproven until controlled training.
ranked_bottlenecks.quantitative_evidence: topology->count 48/48; first-demo->query count 48/48; normalized MI(topology,count)=1.0; query color and rotation phase each constant

ranked_bottlenecks.causal_status: Implementation defect confirmed; contribution to the failed independent result is unquantified.

ranked_bottlenecks.bottleneck: Weak effective query supervision under all-assistant CE and replay dilution
ranked_bottlenecks.causal_status: Allocation confirmed; objective mismatch and replay dilution remain unproven causes.

ranked_bottlenecks.bottleneck: Free-running exact-output acquisition versus token-level fit
